# is-finite [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-finite.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-finite)

> ES2015 [`Number.isFinite()`](https://example.invalid/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Number/isFinite) [ponyfill](https://example.invalid)


## Install

```sh
$ npm install --save is-finite
```


## Usage

```js
var numIsFinite = require('is-finite');

numIsFinite(4);
//=> true

numIsFinite(Infinity);
//=> false
```
